_comment: Places to eat in London: a long-term guide, no dates. Tiers are the categories (A worth planning for, B everyday tables, C coffee, bakeries and bars); costs are the price levels; awards are MICHELIN Guide distinctions. See docs/GUIDES.md. 伦敦餐厅长期导览：分级就是类别（A 值得专程前往，B 日常餐厅，C 咖啡、面包店与酒吧），costs 是价位，awards 是米其林评级。
title: Eating in London, from a bowl of ramen to a tasting menu.
titleZh: 在伦敦吃饭：从一碗拉面到品鉴菜单。
subtitle: {items} places to eat, sorted by category and price. Choose a cuisine or a price, and book the popular ones ahead.
subtitleZh: {items} 个吃饭的地方，按类别和价位分好。可以选菜系或价位；热门的餐厅请提前预订。

tiers.name: Worth planning for
tiers.text: Places in the MICHELIN Guide (★, Bib Gourmand, Guide) and other restaurants worth booking ahead.
tiers.textZh: 米其林指南的餐厅（★、必比登、指南），以及其他值得提前预订的餐厅。

tiers.name: Everyday tables
tiers.text: Good restaurants for any day: noodles, hotpot, curry, small plates and neighbourhood favourites.
tiers.textZh: 哪天都可以去的好餐厅：面馆、火锅、咖喱、小盘菜和街坊常去的小店。

tiers.name: Coffee, bakeries and bars
tiers.text: Coffee, tea, bakeries, pastry and chocolate, and a few bars.
tiers.textZh: 咖啡、茶、面包店、甜点和巧克力，还有几家酒吧。

awards.name: In the Michelin Guide, without a star

themes.nameZh: 意大利、西班牙及地中海菜

themes.name: Thai, Malaysian, Vietnamese and more
themes.nameZh: 泰国、马来西亚、越南等东南亚菜

zones.nameZh: 肯辛顿、切尔西与西伦敦

paras.text: Places to eat in London, from a bowl of ramen to a tasting menu. They come from shared Google Maps lists, and each was checked in November 2026 against the restaurant's own pages, the MICHELIN Guide and the press.
paras.textZh: 从一碗拉面到品鉴菜单，这里是在伦敦吃饭的地方。名单来自几份共享的 Google 地图列表，2026年11月逐一对照了餐厅官网、米其林指南和媒体报道。

paras.text: This guide has no dates: it grows over time. Nothing has been booked for you.
paras.textZh: 本导览没有固定日期，会不断更新。没有代为预订任何餐厅。

items.text: Worth planning for: stars (★), Bib Gourmand and the guide's other picks (Guide), and other places to book ahead. Everyday tables: restaurants for any day. Coffee, bakeries and bars: coffee, tea, pastry, chocolate and a few bars.
items.textZh: 值得专程前往：星级（★）、必比登推介和指南的其他入选餐厅（指南），以及其他值得提前预订的餐厅。日常餐厅：哪天都可以去的餐厅。咖啡、面包店与酒吧：咖啡、茶、甜点、巧克力，还有几家酒吧。

items.text: £ under £20 a head, ££ £20–40, £££ £40–80, ££££ over £80: food for one person, without drinks. The Price box shows one level at a time; Sort by can put the cheapest first.
items.textZh: £ 人均 £20 以下，££ £20–40，£££ £40–80，££££ £80 以上：一个人的餐费，不含酒水。“价位”框一次显示一个价位；“排序方式”可以把便宜的排在前面。

items.text: Choose one in the Cuisine box, or type a dish, a name or a street in Find.
items.textZh: 在“菜系”框里选一种，或者在“查找”里输入菜名、店名或街道。

items.text: Popular places fill up weeks ahead, and some take walk-ins only. A service charge, usually 12.5%, is often added to the bill. Check the opening hours before you go.
items.textZh: 热门餐厅往往要提前几周预订，也有些只接待不预约的客人。账单里常常已经加了服务费，一般是 12.5%。出发前请先确认营业时间。

paras.text: Prices are those the restaurant or the MICHELIN Guide gave in November 2026. Menus change with the seasons, so take them as a guide. Stars, Bib Gourmand and Guide picks are as the MICHELIN Guide's website (Great Britain & Ireland) showed them in November 2026.
paras.textZh: 价格以2026年11月餐厅或米其林指南公布的为准。菜单随季节变化，仅供参考。星级、必比登推介和指南入选，以2026年11月米其林指南网站（英国及爱尔兰）显示的为准。

credits.points: Points: shared Google Maps lists; addresses and details from each place's own pages, the MICHELIN Guide and the press
credits.pointsZh: 点位：几份共享的 Google 地图列表；地址和信息来自各家官网、米其林指南和媒体报道

defaults.price: Prices change: check the restaurant's own page.
defaults.priceZh: 价格会变动，请以餐厅官网为准。
